premise: an arcade football game framed like a live TV broadcast

slots.name: broadcast/panel
slots.note: A large sports broadcast graphics panel: one rectangle of deep broadcast navy (#16255c), completely opaque and solid everywhere including its centre, its face a very subtle vertical gradient (a touch lighter at the top, #1c2d6a, to #142152 at the bottom) with faint fine diagonal sheen lines: no inner rectangle, no vignette. A crisp 1 px lighter navy edge (#33478c). Its top-right and bottom-left corners cut on a 45 degree diagonal, 10 px; no other ornament, no text, no logo. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: broadcast/card
slots.note: A stat card repeated side by side: a flat slab of deep navy (#1a2a63) with a 1 px lighter navy edge (#33478c), its top-right corner cut on a diagonal, and a thin 3 px coral (#f28884) stripe down its left edge. Plain inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: broadcast/field
slots.note: A plain dropdown box: a recessed flat rectangle of dark navy (#0d1842) with a 1 px blue-grey edge (#3a4c86), square corners. Nothing else. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: broadcast/slot
slots.note: A player slot repeated in a grid: a flat square of dark navy (#132257) with a 1 px lighter navy edge (#33478c) and its bottom-right corner cut on a diagonal; its centre plain for a picture. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: broadcast/tooltip
slots.note: A small caption tag: a flat opaque slab of deep navy (#16255c), a 1 px lighter navy edge, and a short coral (#f28884) diagonal slash at its left end. Plain inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: broadcast/hud
slots.note: A broadcast scorebug plate: a flat opaque slab of deep navy (#16255c), a 1 px lighter navy edge (#33478c), a short signal-red (#e8322b) and white diagonal double slash at its left end, its top-right corner cut on a diagonal. Its centre plain. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: broadcast/button
slots.note: A secondary button: a flat slab of navy (#22306a) with a 1 px blue-grey edge (#3f5294), its top-right and bottom-left corners cut on a 45 degree diagonal, 8 px; the label area plain so white italic text reads on it. Hovered: one step lighter. As the inactive tabs of the concept's settings. No glow. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: broadcast/button-primary
slots.note: The primary button: a flat slab of bright coral (#f28884) filling the whole piece, its face an even light coral with the faintest top-to-bottom gradient, so dark navy text reads on it; its top-right and bottom-left corners cut on a 45 degree diagonal, 8 px; a thin white diagonal slash inset at its left end. Hovered: a little lighter. As the selected AUDIO tab and MUSIC row of the concept. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: broadcast/corner
slots.note: A broadcast graphics accent: two short parallel diagonal slashes, one signal red (#e8322b) and one white, each 4 px wide and 18 px long at 60 degrees, in the top-left of the image, on a clear background. Nothing else.

slots.name: broadcast/divider
slots.note: A horizontal divider: one 2 px coral (#f28884) line, even weight from end to end; on a clear background. Nothing else.

slots.name: broadcast/flourish
slots.note: A heading accent: one short slanted bar in coral (#f28884), a parallelogram 10 px wide and 22 px tall leaning right, as the slash before the concept's SETTINGS title; on a clear background. Nothing else.

slots.name: broadcast/thumb
slots.note: A slider's thumb: one round white (#ffffff) puck with a soft 1 px grey edge and the faintest shadow under it, centred, about 16 of 24 px across. Fully transparent around it. As the white handles on the concept's sliders. Nothing else.

slots.name: broadcast/knob
slots.note: Only the sliding knob of a toggle switch: one round white puck, as the knob of the concept's ON toggle. Fully transparent around it.

slots.name: broadcast/knob-off
slots.note: Only the sliding knob of a toggle switch: one round light grey (#c9ccd8) puck. Fully transparent around it.
